name: Agent Principal Model
description: Define the principal-agent model where agents act on behalf of users with inherited capability subsets.
purpose: Establish the security and authority model for the scheduler by defining how agents inherit and exercise user capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: Principal-agent relationship is formally defined in the domain model
Agents acting on behalf of a user inherit a subset of the user's capabilities
Capability supersets and intersections are correctly computed and enforced
Principal delegation chain is recorded and auditable
Capability inheritance is enforced at task dispatch time
